headline: Peruvian Sol Depreciates to S/ 3.458 per Dollar Despite Central Bank FX Interventions
summary: The Peruvian sol weakened to S/ 3.458 per US dollar in spot currency trading despite Central Reserve Bank intervention and higher global copper export prices.
why: Peru's central bank frequently intervenes in spot exchange markets to limit currency volatility in Latin America's top copper exporter.

impacts.name: Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: The sol depreciated 0.23% against the US dollar in spot foreign exchange trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Broad US dollar demand and emerging market currency pressures offset foreign exchange interventions by Peru's central bank.
